messages:
sara-support: FYI customer NimbleApps (acct nimble-342) — invoice INV-2026-0457 was auto-settled but they sent a PO afterwards and need it on the invoice. They want either PO added or a reissued invoice with PO ABC-998. Charge id ch_1J2Kxyz. Settled 2026-03-15. Can we patch metadata on a paid invoice?

maria-cs: Do we have the PO email/thread? quick confirm: was the PO provided after the payment cleared? :eyes:

sara-support: Yep, customer emailed PO yesterday after payment. I attached the PDF to the ticket. They need it for their AP.

james-billing: Stripe/Zuora note: once invoice is settled we can't mutate the invoice doc itself. Typical flow is issue a credit note for the original invoice then create a new invoice referencing the PO and apply the credit.

sara-support: Understood. Is that what we should do for a one-off? Any impact on revenue recognition or tax reporting?

finance-bot: Policy reminder — do not change settled invoice numbers. For customer-requested PO addition post-settlement: 1) issue full credit on INV-2026-0457 2) create new invoice (INV-2026-0457-R) with PO# ABC-998 referenced 3) apply credit to new invoice or mark as paid depending on settlement flow. Tag with "post-settlement-po" and note original invoice id.

leo-ops: Quick repro steps for billing admin (internal):
```
# Create credit
POST /admin/billing/credits
{ "invoice_id": "INV-2026-0457", "amount": 12500, "reason": "Customer PO added post-settlement" }
# Create new invoice with PO
POST /admin/billing/invoices
{ "account_id": "nimble-342", "items": [...], "po_number": "ABC-998", "reference": "reissue_of_INV-2026-0457" }
# Apply credit
POST /admin/billing/credits/apply
{ "credit_id": "<credit_id>", "invoice_id": "<new_invoice_id>" }
```
Note: exact endpoints vary by gateway. For Stripe we'd create a credit note and then an invoice item and finalize.

maria-cs: Do we need a customer signature or approval to issue the credit? They already asked for reissue in email.

james-billing: Keep a copy of their PO email in the billing ticket and add the statement: "Customer requested PO addition; approval recorded." That suffices for audit. Also include refund/credit memo number.

erin-legal: One flag — confirm VAT treatment before crediting. If VAT was recognized on the original invoice period, credit timing could affect VAT reporting. Which country is the customer in?

sara-support: NimbleApps is UK-registered (GB123456789). They specifically mentioned they need PO on invoice for internal AP, no refund wanted — they prefer rebill so totals match.

finance-bot: Action items: 
- james-billing: create credit note and new invoice draft, include PO ABC-998 and reference original invoice. (priority: P2)
- leo-ops: if gateway requires manual capture of payment on new invoice, coordinate to mark paid or apply credit.
- sara-support: confirm PO and payment receipt to customer once done; attach PDF to ticket.
- erin-legal: confirm VAT implication within 24h.

james-billing: I'll take it. Creating credit now and will post the credit memo id here. Template note I use when notifying customer: 
"Hi <name>, we've issued a credit note for INV-2026-0457 and reissued invoice INV-2026-0457-R which includes your PO# ABC-998. Please confirm receipt and we'll apply the credit immediately."

sara-support: thanks james. Please also indicate whether we will auto-apply the credit or refund + rebill (they prefer no refund to bank).

james-billing: We'll apply the credit to the reissued invoice so there's no outbound refund. That preserves the settled cash position. Will update with IDs. :white_check_mark:

leo-ops: When you have the IDs, paste the accounting lines we should send to NetSuite: e.g., credit memo CN-2026-078, new invoice INV-2026-0457-R, apply credit.

james-billing: Credit created: CN-2026-078 (amount 12500 GBP). New invoice draft INV-2026-0457-R created with PO ABC-998. Applying credit now...

finance-bot: Confirmed credit applied. Accounting entries queued. Please file ticket with tag `post-settlement-po` and close once customer confirmation is received.

sara-support: I'll send the customer the note and attach the new invoice PDF. Will update thread once they ack.

erin-legal: Thanks — I'm good with the approach pending VAT check.

maria-cs: Marking as "escalation resolved by billing" pending customer ack. :thumbsup:
